raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “Western Roman Emperor” as implying an Italian country of origin and prematurely concluded the task. This oversimplified a historical affiliation into a modern nation-state, without verifying Anthemius’s actual origin. Anthemius was an Eastern Roman (Byzantine) aristocrat, commonly noted as of Greek origin and born in Constantinople, so equating his title with “Italy” was incorrect and unverified.
